name: Hand-Held Torch
description: Lights up dark areas and keeps you warm. Can also be used for close-range combat in a pinch. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

name: Primitive Workbench
description: Primitive Workbench for producing simple items. Pals with Handiwork suitability help speed up production.

name: Stone Axe
description: An axe for cutting wood. Made from stone, it's not very sharp.

name: Stone Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe used for mining. Made from stone, the efficiency is questionable.

name: Wooden Club
description: A Wooden Club for close range combat. Can beat a small Pal to a pulp if need be.

name: Campfire
description: Used to make simple food or provide meager warmth and light.

name: Pal Dressing Facility
description: Pal Dressing Facility. Give your Pals a new look! Skins obtained inside and outside the game can be applied here!

name: Pal Sphere
description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. This basic model is only effective on low level Pals.

name: Palbox
description: Facility for storing captured Pals. Pals inside gradually recover Health. The area around this structure will become your base.

name: Repair Bench
description: Repairs damaged weapons and tools.

name: Wooden Chest
description: Used to store items. Place at a base and Pals with Transporting suitability will automatically carry items to it.

name: Wooden Structure Set
description: Set for building bases using wood. Allows building of wooden foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.

name: Arrow
description: Arrows for use with bows. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

name: Global Palbox
description: A facility that can store the genetic data of Pals and allows you to reconstruct them from this data. The stored genetic data can also be transferred to other worlds.

name: Old Bow
description: Primitive long-range weapon. Hastily put together, it isn't very powerful. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

name: Shoddy Bed
description: Human bed. Sleeping restores Health. Sleep at night and time will pass until morning. Cannot sleep unless built under a roof.

name: Stone Spear
description: Useful for close-range combat. Its length allows you to stand further away when attacking.

name: Straw Pal Bed
description: Pals at base recover SAN when sleeping in beds at night. Without a Pal Bed, Pals cannot sleep soundly, and no SAN is recovered.

name: Cloth
description: Cloth woven from Wool. Required to create armor.

name: Cloth Outfit
description: Clothes made from Cloth. Protects against cold nights. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

name: Common Shield
description: Strange shield made with Paldium technology. It automatically repair itself after not taking damage for a while.

name: Feed Box
description: Place food here, and Pals at the base will eat from it.

name: Berry Plantation
description: Can produce berries at a base. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

name: Normal Parachute
description: A glider for soaring through the air. Cheaply made, it isn't very fast.

name: Ranch
description: Ranch for raising sheep and fowl-like Pals. Assign Pals with the appropriate work suitability to the ranch to automatically produce items.

name: Wooden Living Room Furniture Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Place furniture in your living space and enjoy life with your Pals.

name: Wooden Tavern Cabinet Furniture Set
description: Set of wooden cabinets that look at home in a tavern. Can store items.

name: Wooden Tavern Furniture Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Set up a bar and enjoy life with your Pals.

name: Fire Arrow
description: Fire Arrows for use with bows. Deals damage on contact. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

name: Foxparks' Harness
description: Harness for holding Foxparks. Activate its Partner Skill to hold Foxparks and attack using it as a flamethrower.

name: Houseplant Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Place plants around your base for a splash of color.

name: Mounted Torch
description: Place it at a base to light the surrounding area.

name: Pal Gear Workbench
description: Produces items that allow Pals to use Partner Skills.

name: Rushoar Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Rushoar.

name: Sign
description: Can be written on.

name: WallSignBoard
description: A signboard to write on. Can be hung on walls.

name: Alarm Bell
description: Bell that sets the alert status for Pals on base. Change Pal behavior to either attack invading enemies or focus entirely on work whenever you like.

name: Bat
description: Baseball bat for close-range combat. Might be tough to get a home run with a Pal.

name: Logging Site
description: Can produce wood at a base. Requires Pal with Lumbering suitability.

name: Melpaca Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Melpaca.

name: Monitoring Stand
description: Command your Pals to work on various things inside a base. You can allow or prohibit individual kinds of work.

name: Sandbag
description: Pals assigned to it will watch for approaching enemies.

name: Stone Pit
description: Can produce stone at a base. Requires Pal with Mining suitability.

name: Wall-Mounted Houseplant Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Place plants on your base's walls for a splash of color.

name: Crusher
description: Facility for breaking down Stone and Wood to exchange them for other materials. Requires Pal with the Watering suitability to spin the water turbine.

name: Fireplace Set
description: Brick fireplace set to provide illumination. Must be lit with fire.

name: Hanging Trap
description: Catches Pals that pass through. Only effective on small Pals and humans.

name: Poison Arrow
description: Poison Arrows for use with bows. Afflicts target with <uiCommon id=|ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Poison| style=|Effect_Poison|/> on contact. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

name: Wooden Defensive Wall
description: Massive defensive wall to prevent enemy intrusions. Made from wood, it breaks easily.

name: Wooden Gate
description: Wooden gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.

name: Carpet Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Place on a foundation in your base for that homey feel.

name: Direhowl's Saddled Harness
description: Saddle for safely riding Direhowl.

name: Hot Spring
description: Pals recover SAN while in a Hot Spring.

name: Small Feed Bag
description: Unlocks a food slot in your inventory. Players and Pals automatically consume food when hungry.

name: Statue of Power
description: Make offerings to enhance the stats of the Player and their Pals.

name: Tropical Outfit
description: A Cloth Outfit produced in hot regions. Boasts high heat resistance. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

name: Tundra Outfit
description: A Cloth Outfit produced in cold regions. Useful for surviving in cold climates. Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

name: Antique Storage Set
description: Antique storage furniture set. Can store items.

name: Bear Trap (Small)
description: Immobilizes those who step on it. Only effective on small Pals or humans.

name: Egg Incubator
description: Place a Pal Egg inside to incubate it.

name: Feathered Hair Band
description: A beautiful feathered headband. Though improbable, it somehow seems to protect its wearer from lethal head injuries. Can be crafted at Workbench.

name: Ladder
description: A ladder that allows you to climb to a slightly higher place.

name: Nail
description: Necessary for building various facilities. Can be made with a Primitive Workbench.

name: Primitive Furnace
description: Uses Ore to produce Ingots.

name: Three Shot Bow
description: An enhanced bow that allows three arrows to be fired simultaneously. By some strange mechanism, it only consumes a single Arrow when fired.

name: Antique Chair Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Use with an antique desk.

name: Chillet Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Chillet.

name: High-Quality Workbench
description: Produces faster than Primitive Workbench. Requires Pal with Handiwork trait.

name: Lifmunk's Submachine Gun
description: Submachine gun made specifically for Lifmunk. Activate its Partner Skill, and Lifmunk will ride on your head and fire at enemies.

name: Metal Axe
description: A metal axe capable of cutting down even hard trees. Effective against the sturdy trees that grow deep within the continent. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Metal Pickaxe
description: A pickaxe used for mining. Made from metal, its durability and efficiency have improved. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Rayne Syndicate Flag Set
description: Rayne Syndicate Standard and Rayne Syndicate Vertical Banner set. Proof of your victory over the Rayne Syndicate.

name: Eikthyrdeer Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Eikthyrdeer.

name: Faux Greenery Set
description: A decorative artificial tree set. Use them to create a natural-looking base. No materials can be obtained from this structure.

name: Grappling Gun
description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. It allows for easy movement between places with varying elevation.

name: Meat Cleaver
description: Knife for butchering Pals. When equipped, the Pet command becomes Butcher. Butchered Pals will be gone for good.

name: Medieval Medicine Workbench
description: Can produce simple medicine. Requires Pal with Medicine Production trait.

name: Pelt Armor
description: Armor made from Leather. Its warmth and defense have been improved. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Tanzee's Assault Rifle
description: Assault rifle made specifically for Tanzee. Activate its Partner Skill, and Tanzee will enter gunner mode and begin shooting at nearby enemies.

name: Tidy Table Set
description: A neat decorative table set for building a clean and well-kept base.

name: Antique Storage Cabinet Set
description: Antique storage cabinet set. Can store items.

name: Cooler Box
description: Small food vault. Assign an Ice Pal to help prevent food stored inside from spoiling.

name: Crossbow
description: Fires an Arrow effortlessly. Though it takes time to load, it delivers a powerful shot. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Metal Chest
description: Can be used to store more items. Pals with Transporting suitability will automatically carry items to it.

name: Metal Spear
description: Useful for close-range combat. The metal tip gives it increased attack power. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Training Dummy
description: Training dummy shaped like a Pengullet.

name: Antique Desk Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Use with an antique chair.

name: Average Feed Bag
description: A decently sized pouch for holding food. Unlocks 2 food slots in your inventory. Players and Pals automatically consume food when hungry.

name: Faux Crimson Foliage Set
description: A decorative artificial autumn tree set. Use them to create a natural-looking base. No materials can be obtained from this structure.

name: Mega Sphere
description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Its capabilities have been improved, allowing it to catch a wider range of Pals. Can be crafted at Sphere Workbench.

name: Pal Essence Condenser
description: Combines several Pals of the same type to create a higher-ranked version.

name: Sphere Workbench
description: Produces Spheres for capturing Pals. Requires Pal with Handiwork suitability.

name: Univolt Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Univolt.

name: Wall Torch
description: Place it on a wall to light the surrounding area.

name: Arsox Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Arsox.

name: Beginner Fishing Set
description: Beginner-friendly fishing rod and bait set. Once you craft both, you'll be able to fish for Pals near bodies of water.

name: Hip Lantern
description: A lantern that can be attached to the hip. It lights up automatically at night. Just one is enough to find your way in the dark.

name: Mill
description: Facility for milling Wheat to produce Flour. Requires Pal with the Watering suitability to spin the water turbine.

name: Nitewing Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Nitewing.

name: Viewing Cage
description: Container for observing captured Pals. Pals inside cannot participate in battle or production, but they do not become hungry.

name: Wheat Plantation
description: Use it to grow ingredients for Bread. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

name: Antique Bath Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Can't actually be used to stay clean.

name: Antique Mirror Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Essentially for making sure you look good.

name: Faux Golden Foliage Set
description: A decorative artificial yellow autumn tree set. Use them to create a natural-looking base. No materials can be obtained from this structure.

name: Heat Resistant Pelt Armor
description: A Pelt Armor produced in hot regions. Boasts high heat resistance. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Lockpicking Tool v1
description: No key? No problem! These tools will allow you to try and pry open any treasure chest that would normally require a Copper Key.

name: Mega Shield
description: Strange shield made with Paldium technology. The new model has been improved, enhancing its defense. Can be made at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Surfent Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Surfent.

name: Cooking Pot
description: Can efficiently prepare more varieties of foods.

name: Heater
description: Warms the nearby area and protects against the cold.

name: Mega Grappling Gun
description: It fires a hook that latches on to distant targets, pulling the user's body towards the target. Since it's upgraded, it now has greater range.

name: Metal Shelf Set
description: Metal shelf set. Can store items.

name: Pengullet Rocket Launcher
description: Rocket launcher for launching Pengullet. Activate its Partner Skill to fire Pengullet and damage enemies. After firing, Pengullet will become incapacitated.

name: Piano Furniture Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Place in your base and dream about living a life of luxury.

name: Primitive Sword
description: A sword for close-range combat. Not bad for a battered sword. Perfect for getting up close and personal.

name: Tombstone
description: A gravestone that can be inscribed with text. Use it for recording purposes.

name: Antique High Quality Furniture Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Gives an air of stately elegance to your base.

name: Bathroom Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Can't be used for its original purpose.

name: Cold Resistant Pelt Armor
description: A Pelt Armor produced in cold regions. Useful for surviving in cold climates. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Cooler
description: Cools the nearby area and protects against the heat.

name: Mega Glider
description: A glider for soaring through the air. A mass produced commercial model, it’s decently fast. Can be made at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Ring of Mercy
description: Pacifist's ring. The wearer's attacks will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

name: Tocotoco's Gloves
description: Gloves for gently holding Tocotoco. Activate its Partner Skill to hold Tocotoco and use it to fire explosive eggs.

name: Breeding Farm
description: Assign a male and a female Pal to produce eggs. Cake is required for breeding.

name: Cement
description: Cement used for creating structures and more. Can be produced in a High-Quality Workbench.

name: Grintale Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Grintale.

name: Heavy Weight Module
description: Equipping it makes the sphere heavier, reducing its range but increasing its capture power.

name: Pal Labor Research Lab
description: A facility for conducting research on the various tasks of Pals. By assigning tasks to Pals in this facility, research progresses, granting various benefits.

name: Stone Defensive Wall
description: Large defensive wall that protects from enemy invasions.

name: Stone Gate
description: Stone gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.

name: Stone Structure Set
description: Set for building bases using stone. Allows building of stone foundations, walls, ceilings, stairs and other things necessary for shelters.

name: Antique Couch Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Gives the air of luxury to your base.

name: Dimensional Pal Storage
description: A facility for storing a large number of captured Pals. Any guild member can deposit or withdraw Pals. If you set it to private, it can serve as your personal Pal storage.

name: Elphidran Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Elphidran.

name: Free Pal Alliance Flag Set
description: Free Pal Alliance Standard and Free Pal Alliance Vertical Banner set. Proof of your victory over the Free Pal Alliance.

name: Giga Sphere
description: An item that captures Pals when thrown. Able to capture moderately powerful Pals. Can be crafted at Sphere Workbench.

name: Large Toolbox
description: Place in base to improve handiwork speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

name: Sweepa Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Sweepa.

name: Tarantriss Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Tarantriss.

name: Weapon Workbench
description: Produces simple mechanical weapons. Requires Pal with Handiwork suitability.

name: Antique Dresser
description: Dresser useful for giving yourself a remake. Allows players to edit their appearance.

name: Bear Trap (Large)
description: Immobilizes those who step on it. Only effective on large Pals.

name: Coarse Ammo
description: Ammo for the Musket, Makeshift Handgun, and similar weapons. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

name: Eikthyrdeer Terra Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Eikthyrdeer Terra.

name: Flame Cauldron
description: Place in base to improve fire-making speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

name: Gunpowder
description: Gunpowder used to fire ammunition. Required to make bullets. Can be made at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Musket
description: Simple, old-fashioned gun. Fires a single, powerful shot at the expense of a long reload time. Can be crafted at Weapon Workbench.

name: Tomato Plantation
description: Farm for producing tomatoes. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

name: Vanwyrm Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Vanwyrm.

name: Clock Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Doesn't actually tell time.

name: Flea Market (Items)
description: A facility for selling items. By setting products in the sales list, you can sell items to other players. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

name: Flea Market (Pals)
description: A facility for selling Pals. By setting Pals in the sales list, you can sell them to other players. Assign an Ice Pal to it and the food inside will be less likely to spoil.

name: Homeward Thundercloud
description: Transports you to the nearest base. Cannot be used in dungeons and other similar locations.

name: Metal Chair and Desk Set
description: Decorative furniture set. Match with metal structures and enjoy life with your Pals.

name: Pal Expedition Station
description: A facility that allows Pals to be sent on expeditions to places like dungeons. The dispatched Pals engage in battles and gather items, bringing back resources to the base.

name: Stun Baton
description: Close range weapon that sends out an electric jolt upon contact. Pals are easier to capture when electrocuted. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Vanwyrm Cryst Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Vanwyrm Cryst.

name: Curve Module
description: Equipping it causes the sphere to spin with a curved trajectory. It becomes easier to catch Pals off guard, and increases capture power.

name: Faux Bamboo Set
description: A decorative artificial bamboo set. Use them to create a Bamboo Grove-inspired base. No materials can be obtained from this structure.

name: Kingpaca Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Kingpaca.

name: Large Feed Bag
description: A large pouch for holding food. Unlocks 3 food slots in your inventory. Players and Pals automatically consume food when hungry.

name: Metal Armor
description: Armor made of metal. Somewhat heavy, but provides good defense. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Metal Helm
description: A helm made of metal. A reliable piece of armor that protects your head, and all the thoughts within. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Storage Container Set
description: Container furniture set. Can store items.

name: Water Fountain
description: Place in base to improve watering speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

name: Azurobe Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Azurobe.

name: Dinossom Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Dinossom.

description: Place in base to improve gathering speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

name: Fluffy Pal Bed
description: Pals sleep more soundly, improving the amount of Health and SAN recovered while sleeping.

name: Foxparks Cryst's Harness
description: Harness for holding Foxparks Cryst. Activate its Partner Skill to hold Foxparks Cryst and release freezing air to attack.

name: Makeshift Handgun

name: Medicine Rack
description: A shelf for storing medicine. Sick Pals will come here to take their medicine. Be sure to keep the medicine stocked.

description: Facility for producing Ore. Mining Ore is hard work that requires physical endurance. Leave it to Pals skilled at mining.

name: Boost Gun
description: PalDopingShot

name: Boost Gun Ammo
description: en text

description: Improved Metal Armor. Boasts high heat resistance. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

name: Helzephyr Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Helzephyr.

description: Farm for producing lettuce. Requires Pal with Planting, Watering, and Gathering suitabilities.

description: Place in base to improve planting speed. Placing more than one has no additional effect.

description: Saddle for safely riding Surfent Terra.

description: Antique lamp set to provide illumination. Requires electricity to light.

name: Fenglope Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Fenglope.

name: Lamp
description: Lights up dark areas at a base.

description: A submachine gun handmade from scraps. It excels in rate of fire, but its single-shot power is low.

name: Mounted Crossbow
description: Assign a Pal with Handiwork suitability and it will protect a base using the crossbow.

description: Electric Pals at the base can now store electricity, allowing the use of electric facilities.

description: Improved Metal Armor. Useful for surviving in cold climates. Can be crafted at High-Quality Workbench.

description: A decorative artificial tropical tree set. Use them to create a tropical-inspired base. No materials can be obtained from this structure.

description: Creates Pal Spheres at a faster pace. Requires Pal with Handiwork suitability.

description: Saddle for safely riding Mammorest.

description: Saddle for safely riding Pyrin.

description: Metal gate large enough for big Pals to pass through.

description: A shotgun handmade from scraps. It has a short range but excels in close-range combat

description: Makes Mossanda fire a grenade launcher when ridden.

description: PalHealingGrenade

description: Saddle for safely riding Broncherry.

description: Saddle for safely riding Pyrin Noct.

name: Blazehowl Noct Saddle
description: Saddle for safely riding Blazehowl Noct.

name: Plasma Rifle
description: A rifle that releases an electrical discharge from the point of impact, which chains to multiple enemies.

name: Jetragon's Missile Launcher
description: Makes Jetragon fire missiles when ridden.

name: Lightweight Ancient Armor
description: Refined Ancient Armor. It is equipped with ancient auxiliary mechanisms, allowing the wearer to carry more supplies.

name: Beam Launcher
description: Fires a high-density beam that causes explosions over a wide area. Caution is required to prevent overheating during rapid fire.

name: Wing Cell
description: The fuel required to power the Wing Pack.

name: Wing Pack
description: A portable glider that enables flight. Consumes Wing Cell to propel the user through the skies.
